name: Yoga school in Tel Aviv
reason: No usable school after three searches. Studio Naim (naim.org.il, robots allows us) runs a 200-hour training but is a 16-branch studio chain whose site also sells dance, gym, fitness and pilates, with yoga-therapy tracks: out of scope as a fitness-led chain. The Iyengar Yoga Center Neve Tzedek-Noga (yoga-center.co.il, founded 1995 by Gabi Doron, officially recognised by B.K.S. Iyengar; robots allows us; email yoga@yoga-center.co.il) is a good lineage school, but its Wix site has no teacher-training page (only a weekly 'class for teachers'), its workshops have no item URLs we could read, several classes are therapeutic or back-and-joint led (health rule), and every photo is on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses our robots.txt request, so it would be thin and held. Owner may want to revisit it if Wix images become usable. Possible future listing: Gabi Doron.
